Clean-exit baseline is incomplete: the executed harness exited 1 and Chromium was force-killed (exit code 1) after the connected-browser close path failed to terminate it. The delivered harness contains the post-run cleanup fix, but no rerun was performed. All six images were captured and verified before cleanup.
redaction: Public copy omits machine username, absolute paths, full browser argv, CDP/debug endpoints, and raw debug logs. Local-only records remain in the gitignored outputs/ directory inside the repository worktree.

harness.note: The delivered harness now calls BrowserServer.close() for a launched server before any force-kill, and the review fixes make the output root configurable (FPS_CAPTURE_OUT_ROOT), create an exclusive preflight.json, ignore untracked files in the tracked-clean check, record httpServerListeningAfterClose with direct semantics, split self-reported vs observed exit codes, and print fatal errors to stderr. No capture or rerun was performed because the task forbids overwriting the exclusive output root or switching roots. A second review pass also distinguishes capture-failed from exit-baseline-incomplete, tees this process's stderr into PW_DEBUG_LOG, writes harness-fatal.json only after the output root is successfully claimed, and derives the local-evidence location note from the actual output root. A third review pass adds measured dependency verification before the build: it reads package-lock.json, hashes it, compares the installed vite/playwright/pngjs/three/typescript versions with the lock entries, fails on any mismatch, and derives environment.dependencies/packageLockSha256 from the measured values instead of hardcoded or caller-supplied ones.

cleanupDeviation.cause: The executed harness called browser.close() on a connect()ed browser, which only disconnects the client; after 15 s the harness force-killed the launched Chromium. All six captures and every validation check had already passed.
cleanupDeviation.postRunFix: The delivered harness now calls BrowserServer.close() for a launched server before any force-kill. No rerun was performed because the task forbids overwriting the exclusive output root or switching roots. A second review pass also distinguishes capture-failed from exit-baseline-incomplete, tees this process's stderr into PW_DEBUG_LOG, writes harness-fatal.json only after the output root is successfully claimed, and derives the local-evidence location note from the actual output root. A third review pass adds measured dependency verification before the build (package-lock.json SHA-256 plus the installed versions of vite/playwright/pngjs/three/typescript checked against the lock), with environment.dependencies and packageLockSha256 derived from those measurements.

reviewAmendments.note: Review fixes applied to README, harness, manifest and report without rerunning capture: configurable output root with harness-created preflight.json, untracked-ignoring tracked-clean check, direct-semantics httpServerListeningAfterClose in all five published occurrences, split selfReportedExitCode/observedExitCode, top-level complete=false with status, corrected local-evidence location to the gitignored outputs/ inside the worktree, and surfaced per-camera usage/comparison conditions. A second review pass fixed the remaining README comparison preconditions, the match fields, dead manifest URLs (shots now carry relativeUrl), rerun prerequisites, debug-log capture, output-root-safe fatal handling, conditional status, and output-root-derived redaction text. A third review pass added the dependency verification described in harness.note, so the rerun prerequisites now state exactly what is checked; the delivered harness hash above refers to the file after this change.
